limits: Official stage command walls and model_case measured wall are reported. FNIT formal wall contains raw preprocessing/anatomy/tracking/eight atlases; stages={} and no modeling wall. No GPU speedup or ten-case completion claim.
nonspatial_spacing_metadata_note: Original contracts unchanged. Direction axis3 has 3 vector components, so NaN spacing has no physical direction-axis interval. SH coefficients and scalar-tissue singleton axes also have no spatial axis3 interval; inherited numeric values are not spatial distances.
CSD_adoption: Only ordered active-set row-index cache adopted (104963ad); tensor math, masks, response, precision and batch unchanged. Lifetime/empty-cache candidates not adopted; allocator environment results separate.

report.subject: CON07
report.scope: Existing same-input CPU tensor diagnostic vs its own official reference; no independent raw-chain FA comparison, no tensor refit/model solver/GPU
interpretation: The sole angle >0.001 degree occurs at the same voxel as the maximum FA difference. Official saved vector matches the absmax eigenvector of its saved tensor (antipodal angle 0).

The official tensor top absolute eigenvalue gap is 0.0005813513481298582, relative gap 0.07586837436004422; it is not an exactly repeated top eigenvalue. CPU FA 3.7291164600716797e-10 is consistent with an almost isotropic tensor, but CPU eigenvalues were not saved and the exact gap/cause is unverified.

Input DWI and gradient SHA match the existing same-input diagnostic and official contract, geometry matches, and the other 109400 finite pairs have angle <=0.001 degree. A global axis/gradient mismatch is not supported by this pattern; a specific cause is not established.
limitations: CPU diagnostic saved FA and direction but no tensor coefficients/eigenvalues; CPU eigengap cannot be recovered from these outputs. No tensor refit was performed.
Eigenanalysis uses only existing official float32 tensor, float64 NumPy eigh; no numeric output or selection threshold changed. Counts at listed angle cutoffs are descriptive only.

A single official eigengap does not by itself identify the cause of the CPU vector difference; gradient input SHA matches prior diagnostic, and output geometry is checked, but CPU tensor coefficients remain unavailable.
